sql: SELECT 'payment_rows' metric,COUNT(*) n FROM olist_order_payments UNION ALL SELECT 'payment_keys',COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id,payment_sequential FROM olist_order_payments) UNION ALL SELECT 'item_rows',COUNT(*) FROM olist_order_items UNION ALL SELECT 'order_category_rows',COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT i.order_id,p.product_category_name FROM olist_order_items i JOIN olist_products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'unknown_category_items',COUNT(*) FROM olist_order_items i JOIN olist_products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NULL

WITH oc AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.order_id,p.product_category_name category FROM olist_order_items i JOIN olist_products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL), dedup AS (SELECT category,payment_type,COUNT(*) n FROM oc JOIN olist_order_payments USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2), naive AS (SELECT p.product_category_name category,pay.payment_type,COUNT(*) n FROM olist_order_items i JOIN olist_products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id JOIN olist_order_payments pay ON pay.order_id=i.order_id GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT d.*,n.n item_join_count FROM dedup d JOIN naive n USING(category,payment_type) ORDER BY d.n DESC LIMIT 15

WITH oc AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.order_id,p.product_category_name category FROM olist_order_items i JOIN olist_products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL), counts AS (SELECT category,payment_type,COUNT(*) number_of_payments FROM oc JOIN olist_order_payments USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2), ranked AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY category ORDER BY number_of_payments DESC,payment_type) rn FROM counts) SELECT category,payment_type,number_of_payments FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY number_of_payments DESC,category LIMIT 3

WITH oc AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.order_id,p.product_category_name category FROM olist_order_items i JOIN olist_products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL), counts AS (SELECT category,payment_type,COUNT(*) number_of_payments FROM oc JOIN olist_order_payments USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2), ranked AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY category ORDER BY number_of_payments DESC,payment_type) rn FROM counts) SELECT category,payment_type,number_of_payments FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY number_of_payments DESC,category LIMIT 3

WITH oc AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.order_id,p.product_category_name category FROM olist_order_items i JOIN olist_products p USING(product_id)) SELECT category,COUNT(*) events,COUNT(DISTINCT pay.order_id) orders,COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT pay.order_id) additional_events FROM oc JOIN olist_order_payments pay USING(order_id) WHERE payment_type='credit_card' AND category IN ('cama_mesa_banho','beleza_saude','esporte_lazer') GROUP BY category

WITH repeated AS (SELECT order_id,payment_type,GROUP_CONCAT(payment_sequential) seq,COUNT(*) n,SUM(payment_value) value FROM olist_order_payments WHERE payment_type='credit_card' GROUP BY order_id,payment_type HAVING COUNT(*)>1),oc AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.order_id FROM olist_order_items i JOIN olist_products p USING(product_id) WHERE product_category_name='cama_mesa_banho') SELECT r.* FROM repeated r JOIN oc USING(order_id) LIMIT 5
